## Scope note

First60 is at build step 1 of 7. Only the CLI shell and the strict
business pack loader are built; the conversation engine, booking,
follow-up engine, channels and demo land in later build steps (see
DESIGN.md, section 14). Requests that fit a later build step are
easiest to accept when they are filed against that step. New business
packs, pack validation improvements and CLI fixes fit the current
step. Voice and telephony are out of scope permanently: First60 is
text-first by design.
